missions.title: A Corner for Two
missions.stake: Ayla needs the rain-mark frame under cover. Each carrier can see a different end around the bend.
missions.knowledgeQuestion: When can two people safely act on what each of them sees?

objectives.title: Help Ayla carry the rain-mark frame from its trestles to the covered shelf.

missions.title: A Lane for the Frame
missions.stake: Mina needs to seat a wide-page frame while readers share the landing.
missions.knowledgeQuestion: What should a credential let you do before you check the conditions for yourself?

objectives.title: Check the local turn and deliver Mina’s wide-page frame.
Help the next reader use the frame where the crew put it.

awards.name: Bridge Partner
awards.title: Keeper of the Far Handle
awards.earnedBy: Worked both ends of a rain-mark frame with Ayla. Mina can offer a second keeper at the Lending Hall after you check the local turn.

journal.text: The rain-mark frame reached its covered shelf. Ayla’s mark showed which plank moved. Each carrier could call their own corner clear.
Mina checked the turn at her own landing. A shared lift keeps the cart free and reserves the short lane during the move. The handcart keeps the lane open and uses two rests.
Mina helped a reader at the low stool. The crew used the frame there or brought down a loose page from the higher cradle.

moments.did: You helped the next reader reach the page after the frame moved.

hints.text: Look for Ayla’s frame at the west trestles in Bridge Clearing.
Check the footing before lifting. A notebook can bring Ayla’s earlier mark into view.
Follow the frame to the central hooks, then choose who will hold it while you set up the turn.
At the east shelf, call your own clear corner so both carriers can lower the frame.
Mina’s wide-page frame is on hooks at the west side of the Lending Hall Landing.
Swing the spare rod. Its length shows what the turn at this rail can take.
The handcart needs two rests. If Ayla recognized you in the Forest, you can also ask Mina to call another keeper for the short lift.
Follow the frame from rest to rest and seat it at the low counter or covered upper cradle.
Come back to the place where you left the frame.
A reader is waiting near the low stool.
The height of the frame changes how Mina brings the spread within reach.
Use the seated frame to let the reader try the holder or receive a loose page.
